title: Final Public Mint Execution Decision Gate
purpose: Decide whether the public mint execution path is ready for a separate final human signing decision, or remains NO-GO.
decision_rationale: Phase 27 review found partial contract and governance documentation only
No exact public mint execution script exists in the repository
No wired frontend/API wallet broadcast path exists on the mint surface
Wallet prompt, executable gas harness, receipt generator, and abort wiring remain missing
Public mint execution therefore remains not ready for final human signing
required_before_any_future_execution: complete execution path artifact (script or equivalent review harness)
documented wallet prompt and abort conditions
separate explicit final human signing approval receipt
operator confirmation on chainId 16661, contract address, function, args, value, and gas
